BitLife 77 Privacy Policy

At BitLife 77 (https://bitlife-77.github.io/), we believe that playing games should be fun, safe, and private. This Privacy Policy details our approach to user data and transparency.

1. Zero Personal Data Collection

We do not require account registration, passwords, credit cards, or personally identifiable information (PII) to access or play any game on BitLife 77. You can browse and play all 440+ games completely anonymously.

2. Local Storage & Preferences

BitLife 77 may utilize your browser’s client-side localStorage or session cookies strictly for necessary functional purposes, such as:

  • Saving your game progress, levels, and high scores.
  • Remembering your site preferences (such as Dark Mode or sidebar toggle states).
  • Storing your recently played or favorite games list.

This data is stored solely on your local device and is never transmitted to or stored on our servers.

3. No Intrusive Ads or Tracking Pixels

We do not use invasive third-party ad trackers, spyware, or data brokers. Your browsing habits on BitLife 77 are not harvested or sold to advertisers.

4. Third-Party Game Embeds

Games hosted on BitLife 77 run within secure HTML5 iframes. Some game developers may include their own analytics or save systems within their game code. We encourage users to review the privacy notices of individual game developers if they have specific concerns regarding in-game mechanics.

5. Children’s Online Privacy Protection (COPPA)

BitLife 77 is family-friendly and student-oriented. We do not knowingly collect, solicit, or maintain personal information from children under the age of 13 in accordance with COPPA.

6. Privacy Inquiries

If you have any questions or concerns regarding our privacy practices, please contact us at admin@bitlife-77.github.io.
